question: Should exec, process, and node-host tool results redact secret-shaped output by default, accepting that exact command output may be masked?
rationale: The code-level repair is bounded and tested, but choosing the default semantics for agent-visible command output changes existing behavior and establishes a security boundary that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept redacted output by default
options.body: Land the security-first default with the marker and warning, and consider any explicit raw reveal path as separately reviewed follow-up work.

options.title: Require reveal design before merge
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer-approved, explicitly authorized raw-output mechanism and coverage for both modes are included.

recommendation.title: Accept redacted output by default
recommendation.body: Land the security-first default with the marker and warning, and consider any explicit raw reveal path as separately reviewed follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is repeated ownership of the affected exec/process runtime, and the PR discussion already routes the contract decision there.
